div.p: The final response block is provisional and telemetry has not confirmed delivery. Logged supply is 63 MW at 20:30 against the 70 MW requirement; release now would leave the operating reserve under target.

div.p: At 20:30 the logged resources total 63 MW against a 70 MW operating reserve requirement. Battery discharge is tapering and the final demand-response block is provisional until telemetry confirms delivery. Imports also trend down across the interval. Keep 7 MW of backup procurement available while dispatch confirms the 21:00 state; these logs describe supply, not delivered customer load.
